text:
Situation: Hydralazine hydrochloride 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 280 tablets (24.6 days on hand). Corvale General holds 391 tablets (29.7 days on hand). The current product label names Teva Czech Industries s.r.o. Opava-Komarov as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include hydralazine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides less than 30 days of supply at both sites. No FDA shortage designation exists to trigger allocation programs. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Ascend Laboratories, LLC for 10 mg tablets to replenish both sites (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to qualify Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Cadila Pharmaceuticals Limited, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Chartwell RX, LLC as backup sources (needs: buyer approval).
3. Pharmacy director to approve addition of qualified alternate suppliers to formulary (needs: pharmacy director approval).
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to committee (needs: buyer approval).

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
